rows.grounds: locative indicating the occasion of a solar eclipse
locative indicating the sacred place Kurukṣetra
present tense verb expressing presence or movement

items.question: At which occasion and location is Rāma claimed to be perpetually present?
premises: A solar eclipse is specified as the occasion.
Kurukṣetra is specified as the sacred location.
Rāma is stated to go there always.
items.inference: Therefore Rāma is perpetually present at Kurukṣetra during a solar eclipse.
items.plain_english: At a solar eclipse in Kurukṣetra, Rāma is always present.
